full_judgment:
The main question raised in this Civil Revision under section 115(4) of the Code of Civil Procedure by leave is whether the learned District Judge, Satkhira was justified in rejecting the Civil Revision No. 3 of  2009 summarily by the impugned judgment and order dated 25-10-2009 on the ground of limitation and thereby affirming the order dated 22-6-2008 passed by the learned Assistant Judge (in-charge), Ashasuni, Satkhira in Title Suit No. 25 of .1999 rejecting the application for time for producing witnesses. 

 2. Appearing on behalf of the petitioners Mr Probir Haider, the learned Advocate submits that the learned District Judge, Satkhira erred in law in rejecting the revision summarily on the ground of limitation without properly considering the facts of the case and the case made out by the petitioners and the same has occasioned failure of justice. Mr Haider further submits that the trial court without giving any opportunity to the plaintiff-petitioners to prove their case by adducing evidence curtailed the legal right of the plaintiff-petitioners in rejecting four successive applications filed on 22-6-2008 and the same has occasioned failure of justice. 

 7. In revision, the learned District Judge, Satkhira rejected the revision summarily on the ground of delay of 24 days in filing the revision application without discussing and considering any reasons for delay as stated in the separate application under section 5 of the Limitation Act for condoning the delay of 24 days in filing the revision application.
